categories.name: Central Storage
categories.description: information on the storage that the sample(s) will be added to.

categories.name: Sample Information
categories.description: What is being added to the store: raw samples, or existing AnnData / SpatialData tables.

categories.name: Run params
categories.description: Raw samples only: CellTypist labels added to each sample. Ignored for existing AnnData / SpatialData tables, which go in as they are.

parameters.name: Storage Location
parameters.description: Icechunk repo (data asset, local path or s3://bucket/prefix) or .zarr folder the samples are added to. If it does not exist, it is created at an s3:// prefix you can write to, or inside /results or /scratch.
parameters.help_text: A store you will keep adding to belongs on S3. /data is read-only; a store in /results can be saved as a data asset but is then read-only too, and /scratch is cleared when the run ends.

parameters.name: Origin of s3(optional)
parameters.description: If the storage is a read-only data asset linked to an S3 bucket, the bucket location to write to. EX: s3://bucket/prefix
parameters.help_text: This is optional, Only needed when writing to an external data asset that has a linked s3 bucket

parameters.name: Input type
parameters.description: Raw samples get QC metrics, CellTypist labels and Scrublet scores. Existing AnnData / SpatialData tables go in as they are (nothing recomputed; a new store from one object keeps its layers and embeddings, later objects add cells, counts and the store's obs columns), identified by their sample_id column, or the file name without one.
parameters.help_text: Both kinds can go into the same store. A different column can name the samples with the SAMPLE_COLUMN environment variable.
extra_data: Existing AnnData or SpatialData table (as is)

parameters.name: List of paths to samples
parameters.description: Raw samples (.h5/.h5ad files, SpatialData .zarr folders) or existing AnnData (.h5ad, AnnData .zarr, SpatialData .zarr tables), folders holding them, or globs, separated by commas. EX: /data/samples, /data/atlas.h5ad
parameters.help_text: Paths must be inside data assets attached to this capsule. Folders are not searched recursively. Samples already in the store are skipped. MuData isn't supported; ingest a modality as AnnData.

parameters.name: Celltypist Model
parameters.description: Which CellTypist models label the cells. A store built from raw samples accepts only the option it was created with; one seeded from an existing AnnData keeps its own columns and warns about the rest.
extra_data: CellTypist Immune_All High and Low labels

parameters.name: Custom Celltypist model (.pkl, optional)
parameters.description: A CellTypist model file to use instead of the dropdown, e.g. one trained for a spatial gene panel. Several can be separated by commas. EX: /data/models/my_model.pkl
parameters.help_text: Leave empty to use the dropdown. The model's name (the file name without .pkl) names the label columns, so keep using the same file for one store.
